user.title: Load Detective
user.description: Pick the sensor that reports your whole home's power use (for a Powerwall, the home load / load power sensor).

devices.title: Devices to watch
devices.description: Load Detective learns each device's wattage from how much your home's power jumps when it turns on or off. Lights under about 20 W usually can't be measured; give those a wattage below. For an oil or gas boiler with several zones, put all the zone thermostats under Boiler zones instead of Devices.

data.exclude: Leave these out of the groups
data.watts_text: Known wattages, one per line (for example  media_player.tv: 110)
data.learn_days: Days of history to learn from at startup
data.boiler_zones: Boiler zones: thermostats that call the same boiler (counted as one appliance)
data.oil_deliveries_text: Oil deliveries, one per line (for example  2026-11-03: 142.5)
data.oil_rate: Oil per heating hour, if you know it (0 = learn from deliveries)

error.invalid_watts: Each line must look like  light.porch: 9
error.invalid_deliveries: Each line must look like  2026-11-03: 142.5  (date, then gallons)

abort.already_configured: Load Detective is already set up for this sensor.
